name: FRACTURE LINES (AR Urban Territory)
description: Fracture Lines is a persistent AR overlay game covering all of GLMZ, dividing the city into 12,000 capturable nodes that players claim by physically occupying locations and completing timed challenges — parkour routes, puzzle sequences, cryptographic locks — while rival factions attempt to dislodge them in real time. Nodes in Tier 1 districts yield the highest in-game rewards but carry real-world risk, creating a brutal geography where dedicated the Gray Zone players dominate high-value zones that Tier 3-4 players fear to enter. The game has been running continuously since 2188 with no canonical ending.
story_hooks: A Fracture Lines faction leader realizes a rival is using node-capture data to map patrol gaps for an actual heist — and they've been providing the intelligence without knowing it.
A Tier 4 player using a proxy-runner to capture the Gray Zone nodes has accidentally made a the Gray Zone kid a target — the player wants to fix it, but getting to the Gray Zone is its own problem.
The oldest continuously held node in GLMZ — held by a single player since 2191 — suddenly goes dark, and the player has vanished.
